**A firmer tissue box lid: its hooks and latches press outward, so it sits tight and doesn't rattle.** The web version has it too: <https://rickusinggithub.github.io/vaseinator/>.

### Download & run (Windows)
1. Download **Vaseinator.exe** below and run it. It is one file: nothing to unzip or install. SHA256SUMS.txt holds its checksum.
2. The app isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.

No Python needed. To run from source on any OS, see the README. Or just use it in your browser: <https://rickusinggithub.github.io/vaseinator/>.

### Changed in 1.15.3
- **The lid is firmer.** Each hook's and latch's bump used to sit 0.3 mm clear of the ledge, so the lid could rattle. Now each bump is made 0.3 mm into the ledge's steep side: when the lid is on, each tab stays bent in about 0.2 mm and presses outward all the time, which pulls the lid tight against the rim, with no play.
  - It's placed from the cover's measured wall, so it presses even where rings or rounded hole edges change the wall's shape.
  - The guides on the long sides are closer to the wall (0.3 mm, not 0.6 mm), so the lid can't shift sideways.
  - Save the lid again for an existing cover: the cover itself hasn't changed. **Lid grip** (Gentle, Snug, Firm) still sets how hard it is to take off.

Vaseinator is free. If it has made you something you like, you can [buy me a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rickapps).
